title: Missing Async Operation Status Indicator (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Data grid refresh in progress without skeleton shimmer or spinner.
evaluation_rationale: User is unable to determine whether background request is executing or frozen. Severity evaluated at 1/4 per Nielsen severity scale.
suggested_fix: Apply bg-surface-muted animate-pulse with aria-busy="true".

title: Raw Hexadecimal Database UUID in UI Copy (Variant 1)
heuristic_name: Match Between System and Real World
observed_pattern: Displaying internal database UUID c0a80101-3829-4b... to end user.
evaluation_rationale: Internal system abstractions violate natural real-world conceptual vocabulary. Severity evaluated at 2/4 per Nielsen severity scale.
suggested_fix: Format with human-readable entity slug and localized timestamp.

title: Destructive Action Lacking Undo/Cancel Affordance (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Table row deletion executes immediately without undo toast or confirmation.
evaluation_rationale: Users require an emergency exit to recover from unintended clicks. Severity evaluated at 3/4 per Nielsen severity scale.
suggested_fix: Provide undo button in AlertBannerToast with 5-second compensation window.

title: Inverted Action Button Colors (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Danger button styled with emerald green and confirm button styled with crimson.
evaluation_rationale: Inverted semantic color tokens violate platform conventions. Severity evaluated at 4/4 per Nielsen severity scale.
suggested_fix: Bind PrimaryButton to bg-primary-600 and DestructiveButton to bg-status-error.

title: Permanent Workspace Deletion Without Double-Confirmation Gate (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Clicking Delete Workspace immediately terminates tenant.

suggested_fix: Render ModalDialog with confirmation typing requirement before trigger.

title: Crucial Calculation Formula Parameters Hidden on Previous Page (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Tax rate inputs require remembering values from step 1.

title: Low Text Contrast Below WCAG AAA 7:1 Threshold (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Light grey text #94A3B8 on white background #FFFFFF (contrast ratio 3.1:1).
evaluation_rationale: Fails WCAG 2.2 AAA SC 1.4.6 requiring at least 7:1 contrast for normal text. Evaluated under WCAG 2.2 accessibility standard.
suggested_fix: Replace text color with text-content-primary (#0F172A), achieving 15.8:1 contrast.

title: Interactive Form Control Border Below 3:1 Contrast (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: TextInputField border #E2E8F0 on canvas #FFFFFF (contrast ratio 1.2:1).
evaluation_rationale: Fails WCAG 2.2 AA SC 1.4.11 requiring at least 3:1 against adjacent background. Evaluated under WCAG 2.2 accessibility standard.
suggested_fix: Apply border-border-strong (#64748B), achieving 3.8:1 contrast.

title: ModalDialog Traps Keyboard Focus Without Escape Key Exit (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Tab key escapes modal overlay into background body; Escape key does not close.
evaluation_rationale: Violates WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap); disables keyboard-only users. Evaluated under WCAG 2.2 accessibility standard.
suggested_fix: Implement circular focus trap and bind Escape key to closeModal() handler.

title: Missing Focus Visible Ring on Interactive Button (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: PrimaryButton styles outline: none; focus ring completely suppressed.
evaluation_rationale: Keyboard navigators cannot identify currently active element. Evaluated under WCAG 2.2 accessibility standard.
suggested_fix: Apply focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2.

title: Touch Target Smaller than 44x44px Enhanced Standard (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: IconButton dimensions are 24x24px with zero surrounding padding.
evaluation_rationale: Fails WCAG 2.2 AAA SC 2.5.5 Target Size requiring 44x44 CSS pixels. Evaluated under WCAG 2.2 accessibility standard.
suggested_fix: Expand hit target with min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] touch target wrapper.

title: Form Error Communicated Solely Through Red Border Color (Variant 1)
observed_pattern: Input field border turns red with zero error text message or ARIA indicator.
evaluation_rationale: Colorblind users cannot identify which field contains the validation error. Evaluated under WCAG 2.2 accessibility standard.
suggested_fix: Add aria-invalid="true" and render BodyTypography error label below field.
